component.name: DataRecovery
component.summary: Data recovery using ddrescue and PhotoRec

description.p: DataRecovery is a GTK4/Libadwaita application for recovering data from storage devices and disk images. It creates forensic disk images using GNU ddrescue's 4-pass method, then recovers files using PhotoRec.

ul.li: Creates disk images using ddrescue with 4-pass recovery (fast copy, direct I/O retry, reverse retry, final scraping)
Recovers all files (not just deleted ones) using PhotoRec
Automatically organizes recovered files by file type
Optional duplicate file removal using rdfind
Mount detection prevents data corruption on active partitions
System partition protection prevents recovery from running system drives
Disk space validation before operations

description.p: Important: This application requires significant disk space as it creates complete disk images before file recovery. Ideal for recovering data from failing drives or performing forensic analysis.
